english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for people, organizations, skills, or things at the very top.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something that ranks among the very best.
Use this for the best or highest-ranked option in a field, such as a top school.

examples.english: He is a premier surgeon in this field.
examples.traditional: 佢係呢行頂尖嘅外科醫生。

examples.english: This restaurant is considered preeminent in the area, so it is worth paying a little more.
examples.traditional: 呢間餐廳喺區內算係頂尖，貴少少都值得。
